method: Alternating baseline and candidate executables on the same host. Benchmark checks every output against each executable's first complete signed Gamma payoff. Cross-version outputs compared exactly in all pairs.
limitations: Microbenchmark of the payoff compiler used by native Gamma calculation, not an end-to-end numerical acceptance or suite timing. Build activity may overlap the run. No claim that the unrelated native crash is fixed.
